title: Generate a slug from a title
description: Generate stable URL slugs on the server while showing editors the value live in the Admin UI.
problem: You want readable URLs without asking editors to hand-author slugs for every document.
summary: Generate the slug on the server and optionally mirror it live in Admin so titles and URL fields stay aligned.
runtimeNotes: Uses a beforeChange function hook and Admin hook function.
intents: make the URL follow the title
keep a slug synchronized with a title
